correctness.rationale: Each allowed vertex triple has three clockwise arc lengths in [1,m]; their sum is n, since it is a positive multiple of n below 2n. This forces A/B/C noninterlacing and a unique anchored cyclic block decomposition. Widths u,v,w and arc gaps p,q,r satisfy the three exact maximum-distance inequalities; slacks i,j,k form a bijection with six nonnegative variables summing to m-1, with positive converse gaps p=1+w+j+k etc. The width generating function W(z,s)=s(1-z)/(1-(1+s)z) cancels three slack factors, giving F_m(s)=n*binom(m+1,2)*(1+s)^(m-1) for every m>=1. Rotation changes the unique anchor and thus has no nontrivial cell stabilizer. The finite verifier independently enumerates all Hom cells for n=3..19 and confirms each coefficient; for n<=15 it checks all anchors and target-rotation stabilizers. The universal claim is justified by the symbolic bijection, not by testing.

originality.rationale: The full directed-Hom foundational paper defines the objects and proves only a transitive-tournament contractibility theorem, displaying some nontransitive examples and emphasizing dimension in obstruction theory. The closest fully inspected exact published R9 record gives f=(90,270,270,90), and explicitly states it asserts no family formula. This is a specialization at m=4, not a covering theorem for every m. Queries of published-finding corpus and public literature for cyclic/round/locally-transitive targets, cell enumerators, equivariance, and equivalent formulations found no all-m result. An unindexed equivalent enumeration remains possible.
residual_risks: An equivalent all-order cell enumeration may be published under round/locally transitive tournament or cellular box-complex terminology outside indexed/accessible sources.

value.rationale: The result gives an exact complete cellular f-polynomial, maximum dimension, and free quotient orbit counts for every standard cyclic tournament, a canonical nontransitive family. Section 7.2 of arXiv:2108.10948 explicitly motivates dimensions of Hom(C3,H) as equivariant obstruction inputs. The formula implies every odd cyclic target of order at least five gives a noncontractible complex by Euler characteristic zero, in direct structural contrast to the foundational transitive-target contractibility theorem. It is not a merely renamed formula, an isolated parameter increment or a known table recalculation; the six-variable bijection produces a uniform all-order identity. No stronger homotopy classification is claimed.
